title: Mechanical calculators made, from Leibniz to the arithmometer
description: Bar chart on a logarithmic scale. Leibniz's stepped reckoner: 2 machines. Pascal's calculator: about 20, by 1654. Thomas de Colmar's arithmometer: about 1,000 by his death in 1870, and about 5,500 in all, 1851 to 1915. Data: the Wikipedia articles Pascaline, Stepped reckoner, Charles Xavier Thomas and Arithmometer.
heading: MACHINES MADE (LOG SCALE)
